detail: finding: The monitor says the new portal was not functional although the Government adopted information on establishing it in December 2024.
outcome: The new portal improved user information on services, instructions, documents, forms, costs, contacts and legal framework.
finding: The new portal is designed to be citizen-friendly, but the monitored services are not integrated into it.
outcome: The new portal did not improve the monitoring grades, because none of the sampled services are available on it.
finding: Despite some steps such as the ePayment portal, many systems are outdated, user-unfriendly and lack full functionality.
finding: The Government portal is not the only platform for digital services, because other institutions use their own.
finding: The eGovernment portal is the key central platform, while a number of services run through other institutional portals.
recommendation: To raise portal use, the administration should add fully digitalised services and simplify and improve the portal.
